hooks.command: case "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_AUTO_INSTALL:-true}" in [fF][aA][lL][sS][eE]|0|[nN][oO]|[oO][fF][fF]) ;; *) rust-analyzer --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1 || rustup component add rust-analyzer || true ;; esac

auto_install.title: Auto-install language server
auto_install.description: When rust-analyzer cannot run, add it with `rustup component add rust-analyzer` at session start (requires rustup). Turn off to manage rust-analyzer yourself.
